title: NoSQL Databases
subtitle: Partition by key to scale writes, and watch for the key everyone wants
motto: A good partition key spreads load; a hot one concentrates it
keyInsight: Partitioning by key scales writes only as far as the keys are used evenly, and one hot key puts all its load on a single node.

decisions.title: Fail on a hot key, not a node crash
decisions.description: The failure is skewed key usage, since that is what actually breaks partitioned stores and it survives adding nodes.
decisions.alternatives: A node failure is a replication problem, covered elsewhere, and would not teach the partition-key lesson.

decisions.title: Show salting's read cost
decisions.description: The trade-off frame reports how many queries one read now needs, so the fix is shown with its price.
decisions.alternatives: Showing only the lower node utilization would make salting look free.
